description: Image Description: The image shows a close-up of three donuts arranged on a white plate with a thin brown rim. In the foreground, there is a classic glazed donut with a shiny, smooth sugar glaze coating its surface, highlighting its golden-brown color and circular shape with a central hole. Behind it, slightly to the right, is a donut topped with a bright yellow frosting that appears to be unevenly spread, possibly lemon or custard-flavored, with small dark specks
